headline: Oyster auction fee structure tabled until more information is gathered while Fish Exchange manager hiring plans move forward
summary: General manager Robert is leaving at the end of December, so the group discussed how to hire his replacement. They also talked about replacing the auction software and about selling oysters at auction, which was tabled.
decisions: Tabled the fee structure for selling oysters at auction until more information is gathered.
discussion: Fish Exchange manager hiring: Members discussed updating the job description, when and where to post the opening, and a possible interim manager.
Auction software replacement: Members compared the current system with a 5% fee option and a per-pound fee option, and discussed finding a local vendor and grant money.
Offload fee for one fisherman: Members discussed whether to lower the 20-cent-per-pound unload fee to 10 cents to keep a fisherman's business at the exchange.
Oyster sales: Members asked about contamination rules and how to price oysters sold by the pound at auction.

decision_evidence.quote: So we are going to wait to discuss this. We're going to table it for now until we get more information so we can be better prepared to make a decision.

decision_titles: Fee structure for selling oysters at auction
